slides.sub: A three-question way to resolve it.

slides.body: The 10th house (career) looks strong in your main chart. But the D-10 (Dashamsa, the career divisional chart) looks stressed. Which one is right?
They answer different questions. The main chart shows the promise. The D-10 shows how that promise plays out in actual work.
Is the 10th lord strong in both charts, or only one? Strength in both is a consistent signal. Strength in one is a flag to dig deeper.
What does the running dasha (planetary period) activate? A stressed D-10 may only bite when that planet's period is running.
Is there a clear pattern, or just one weak spot? A single affliction is a texture. Several together are a theme.
Rule-based tools check one placement at a time. Synthesising many variables at once is where AI helps, and where a human reads the result.
